verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Drive files can be shared so that others can edit, comment on, or only open them, with a documented 'writer' permission role. This implies collaborative editing of files in place. Nothing in the pack describes simultaneous browser-based co-editing of docs, sheets, or slides. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of real-time multi-user co-editing, browser-based editing of Docs/Sheets/Slides, presence or cursor features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
